description: Design net worth = sum of wallet balances over wallet_evm AND wallet_sol (design...:44-46). v2 R4 (behavioral-spec.md:36-38) reads only the EVM balance of id (id is the 0x EVM address per telemetry-schema.js:5). Solana holdings are silently dropped, understating net worth for any agent holding value on Solana; the spec never acknowledges dropping wallet_sol.

evidence.snippet: set each row's net_worth_usd to the on-chain USDC+native balance of id
